identity.notes: The official Cinemark theatre page and the corporate-linked DoorDash Commerce storefront both identify Cinemark Centreville at 6201 Multiplex Dr, Centreville, VA 20121. The ordering surface has the exact theatre address and is the location-specific current catalog.

sources.excerpt: Official Cinemark page for Cinemark Centreville at 6201 Multiplex Dr, Centreville, VA 20121, phone 703-802-1100. Amenities include Luxury Loungers and Bar/Alcohol.
Cinemark's official food hub describes classic concessions, delivery, and mobile ordering and cautions that menu offerings vary by location.
Cinemark's official delivery page links customers to Order Delivery on its DoorDash Commerce ordering system.

The official updated allergen page links the current 2026 full-circuit spreadsheet, states that items vary by location, says popcorn salt could contain dairy, and warns that trace salt can remain in the popper after previous batches.

Current official 2026 full-circuit nutrition and allergen workbook. It lists nine allergen columns across Restaurant and Concession sheets and says Cinemark does not guarantee any item will be completely food-allergen free.

The corporate-linked DoorDash Commerce storefront identifies 6201 Multiplex Dr, Centreville, VA 20121 and exposes the current location catalog: 77 distinct food and nonalcoholic products after repeated featured listings are consolidated.

Targeted web searches recovered the exact official theatre page, Cinemark food and delivery pages, the current official allergen workbook, and the exact corporate-linked ordering storefront. No conflicting location-specific official matrix was found.

attempts.query: Inspect the official Cinemark Centreville page and Cinemark food, delivery, and allergen pages for exact identity, current menu links, allergen guidance, and cross-contact disclosures.
attempts.outcome: The official site confirmed the exact Centreville theatre, linked its delivery flow, and exposed the current allergen-information page with a location-variation warning and popcorn dairy cross-contact guidance.

attempts.query: Inspect all current files linked by Cinemark's updated nutrition and allergen page, including the 2026 full-circuit XLSX Restaurant and Concession sheets.
attempts.outcome: A current restaurant-issued matrix was found. It supplies product-level Egg, Fish, Milk, Peanut, Shellfish, Soy, Tree Nuts, Wheat, and Sesame declarations plus a general allergen caution. It was applied only where the exact Centreville surface independently confirmed the product.

attempts.outcome: The exact-address linked storefront exposed the complete current 77-product food and nonalcoholic catalog. Descriptions added a small number of direct positives but did not provide a separate comprehensive allergen matrix.

matrixSearch.notes: All four required search classes were completed and the official matrix was found. The 2026 full-circuit workbook is not treated as proof that every corporate item is sold in Centreville; product-level declarations are attached only after the exact linked ordering surface establishes a current Centreville product. Empty allergen arrays remain unavailable rather than absence claims.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: Cinemark does not guarantee that any item will be completely food allergen free.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: Preserved separately as restaurant-level caution. It is not converted into blanket may-contain labels.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: Cinemark says its popcorn salt could contain dairy and trace salt may remain in the popper from previous batches even when staff pop corn without salt.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: Applied conservatively as mayContain milk to current popped-popcorn products and popcorn-containing combos; direct soy declarations come from the official workbook.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: Cinemark's allergen page relays Coca-Cola's confirmation that specified fountain beverages are gluten free.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: Preserved as a supported restaurant-level statement only. It is not converted into empty-allergen certainty or a blanket absence claim for the configurable fountain-drink listings.

findings.summary: Official and restaurant-linked sources consistently resolve to Cinemark Centreville at 6201 Multiplex Dr, Centreville, VA 20121.

The complete exact-location boundary is 77 distinct current food and nonalcoholic products on the Centreville DoorDash Commerce menu. Repeated featured and most-ordered presentations are consolidated without dropping separate size or SKU listings.

The frozen 141-row baseline mixes a broad corporate Restaurant and Concession catalog, headings, promotion text, and products not exposed at Centreville. Most unmatched rows are location mismatches; four are parser artifacts.

The current official 2026 workbook supplies the direct nine-allergen matrix. Declarations were applied only to products present on the exact Centreville surface; unsupported negatives remain unavailable.

Cinemark explicitly warns that popcorn salt could contain dairy and that trace salt may remain in the popper after previous batches. Current popcorn products therefore preserve milk cross-contact separately from direct soy declarations.

The location storefront describes the buttery topping packet as non-dairy, while the current official matrix declares Milk and Soy for Butter Flavored Topping. The official positive declaration is retained; the marketing phrase is not treated as an absence claim.
